description:
Reproduced 2026-09-14 at main f26264572. guard_dispatch_from_surface binds a helper plan's pins by looking up the pin's name among the FIRST clause's Pattern::Var parameters (src/dispatch_matrix/pattern.rs:285-298). A pin is positional and per-clause, so:

    def eqp(0, 0), do: true
    def eqp(b, ^b), do: true
    def eqp(_, _), do: false

called from a case guard fails with error[lower/unbound]: compiler2 case guard references unknown name 'b'. The same failure with def eqp(z, 0) first, because clause 0 names input 0 z.

Dies with fz-21x.24 (guards are code): a guard helper becomes an ordinary function with an ordinary entry plan, and there are no helper pins to bind. Filed so the shape is not lost; if fz-21x.24 slips, the fix is to bind each clause's pins against that clause's own parameters.
title: Guard-helper pins resolve in clause 0's namespace only
